nodes.label: MemoryExtractionJob
nodes.rationale: Hangfire background job that runs after every assistant turn plus a periodic sweep to classify content, category, and sensitivity.

nodes.label: IMemoryService
nodes.rationale: Application-owned interface for memory ranking and selection using a composite score (vector similarity + importance/confidence/recency/frequency).

nodes.label: IMemoryVectorStore
nodes.rationale: Dedicated vector store using SQL Server native vector support, decoupled from RAG's vector store due to different scoping (user+project vs. knowledge base).

nodes.label: Projects Bounded Context
nodes.rationale: Lightweight entity for grouping conversations so memories can be scoped to one project or kept general.

nodes.label: SendChatMessageCommandHandler
nodes.rationale: Existing handler extended to inject memory context as a defensively-framed system message before RAG context.
